sentences.text:
The claimants are before this Court seeking enhancement of compensation assailing legality and correctness of the judgment and award dated 30.01.2015 passed in LACA No.21/2012 by the Court of IV Additional District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi (Hereinafter referred to as 'first Appellate Court' for short), modifying the judgment and award dated 30.06.2010 passed in LAC No.1581/1997 (Hereinafter referred to 'trial Court' for short).
2.

entities.text: Court of IV Additional District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The land of the claimants was acquired under Section 4(1) Notification dated 13.06.1991 for the purpose of Bennethora Project.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer determined market value of the acquired land at Rs.15,000/- per acre.

The reference Court enhanced the market value of acquired land to Rs.32,000/- per acre and in the appeal preferred by the claimants before the first Appellate Court, the first Appellate Court awarded compensation of Rs.59,500/- per acre.
The appellants are seeking for further enhancement in this second appeal.

Learned counsel for the appellants has placed reliance on the decision of Co-Ordinate Bench of this Court in the case of REVANSIDDAPPA S/O. GURAPPA V. THE STATE OF KARNATAKA1 (Revansiddappa) and submits that under the same notification, for the same village, for the same project this Court has awarded compensation of Rs.1,64,223/- per acre and the appellants in the instant case also needs to be awarded the same compensation.
4.

entities.text: REVANSIDDAPPA S/O. GURAPPA V. THE STATE OF KARNATAKA1 (Revansiddappa)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the Nigam/KNNL and the learned AAG along with HCGP Sri Rajkumar Korwar for the State do not dispute that the judgment and award of the Co- Ordinate Bench of this Court squarely applicable to the present facts.

5. The Co-Ordinate Bench of this Court in Revansiddappa's case placing reliance on the judgment and award passed in MSA No.200024/2018 dated 19.02.2018, wherein, the claimants for the acquisition of the lands situated at Nagoor Village acquired in the year 1991 for the purpose of Bennethora Project has been awarded Rs.1,64,223/- per acre.
The lands in question are also acquired by the respondents under Section 4(1) notification dated 13.06.1991 for the purpose of Bennethora Project, which was situated at Nagoor Village.
Accordingly, the appellants are also entitled for compensation in respect of the lands acquired at Rs.1,64,223/- per acre with all statutory benefits with cost.

Accordingly, this Court pass the following:
ORDER i.
The miscellaneous second appeal is hereby allowed in part;
For the delay caused in preferring the appeal before the Appellate Court and before this Court, the appellants are not entitled for the interest for the said period.
